messages:
ana: Quick sync thread — we need a pragmatic path for legacy customers on slab pricing to move to the new tier/add-on model. Proposal: a 90-day 'commit bridge' that maps old slabs to equivalent microtiers + a softcap grace period. 20m sync at 11?

liz: 11 works. Key ask from support: minimize surprise billing and keep soft-fallback messaging clear. Customers hate unexpected throttles.

sam: Product framing: Bridge = 1) convert existing credits into proportional burst bundles, 2) grant a timeboxed softcap uplift to avoid immediate throttles, 3) offer an easy convert-to-commit flow with pro-rated invoices. Need launch criteria and wording.

jenny: Sales prefer a paid bridge (small admin fee) vs free to avoid freebie expectations. Also need a simple upsell CTA in-console.

mohit: Implementation notes: bridge uses existing quota plumbing + temporary token-bucket overrides per-tenant. Softcap grace will be 'non-enforcing' for 30 days then escalate to weighted throttling. Engineering estimate: ~5 days to implement bridge orchestration + 2 days for console UX.

ralph: Commercial ask: map old slab tiers to three microtier equivalents and produce a commit->discount matrix. Also provide a promo (10% first-year discount) if they convert within the 90 days.

legal: I'll draft a short 'Bridge Addendum' that includes the timebox, conversion terms, refund/credit mechanics, and an escape hatch for policy abuse. Must avoid "automatic renewal" phrasing without clear opt-in.

ana (ops-bot): ops-bot: attached usage sample for top-50 legacy tenants and burst patterns: https://internal.redwood/exports/legacy-bridge-sample.csv (uploaded)

liz: Quality guardrail: conversions that change model variants must be flagged and validated against the eval set; less than 4% regression allowed or we hold conversion.

sam: Proposed launch criteria: (A) Bridge logic validated in staging with 5 simulated tenants over 72h with no regressions; (B) Bridge Addendum signed-off by legal + sales playbook; (C) Console showback + billing preview live; (D) Runbook for throttling escalation published.

mohit: Also require observability: per-tenant projected vs actual cost calc, per-route latency deltas during softcap uplift, and an automated alert when a tenant consumes >150% of their historical baseline.

jenny: For sales ops: need a CSV export per-account showing "old slab -> new microtier mapping" and a button to issue the promo credit. Prefer automated convert flow that also creates an MSA amendment if enterprise.

ralph: Pricing pilots: run a small paid pilot (10 customers) with a 15% conversion incentive and a short SLA addendum. Gather conversion rate and support tickets as primary metrics.

legal: Caveats for enterprise: if the MSA prohibits automatic changes, we must surface a manual acceptance path and record explicit consent. Also add export-control checks for data residency accounts.

ana (ops-bot): Attached perf trace snippet for typical legacy bursts: https://internal.redwood/exports/legacy-bursts-trace.json (uploaded)

liz: Customer-facing wording suggestion: "Commit Bridge: a 90-day transition program that converts legacy credits to equivalent microtier benefits and includes a temporary softcap uplift to avoid service interruptions. Conversion is optional and includes a one-time promotional credit if completed within the bridge window." Short and sets expectations.

sam: Agree. Also include in docs: "What happens after the bridge window: customers are placed on mapped microtier with enforced caps unless they convert; overflow will be subject to billed burst bundles or throttling per policy."

mohit: Implementation detail to include in RFC: rollback semantics if bridge orchestration fails (revert quota overrides, publish incident ticket, and notify customer via console banner). Also add a canary: rollout to 5 accounts first.

jenny: Sales ask: surface an estimated monthly cost delta at conversion time and show historical usage that justifies the recommended microtier. That reduces churn.

ralph: Launch metrics to gate GA: conversion rate >= 25% within 60 days for pilot cohort, support tickets increment <= +5% vs baseline, and no SLO regressions >2% p95 latency on core routes. If any fail, freeze GA and iterate.

legal: I'll prepare two doc snippets: (1) bridge consumer-facing FAQ, (2) bridge addendum template for pilots + enterprise amendment checklist. Will share in 48h.

ana: Actions: 
- ana: book 11am sync and create RFC stub (today)
- sam: draft mapping matrix + conversion UX text (tomorrow)
- mohit: infra plan + canary rollout steps + estimate (48h)
- liz: eval prompt set + conversion quality checks (48h)
- jenny: sales convert flow + promo mechanics (48h)
- ralph: pricing pilot list + commit incentives (48h)
- legal: bridge addendum + FAQ (48h)
- ops-bot: attach any additional usage samples to thread

ana: OK I'll consolidate into the RFC and propose pilot customers next sync. Thanks all.

ops-bot: Export links posted: https://internal.redwood/exports/legacy-bridge-sample.csv, https://internal.redwood/exports/legacy-bursts-trace.json
